Patwari and assistant arrested for taking bribe in Sonipat

In Sonipat, Haryana, a Patwari and an assistant were arrested by the ACB (Anti-Corruption Bureau) while accepting a bribe of ₹7,000. The bribe was allegedly for registering a mutation and providing a copy. The ACB team set a trap to apprehend them.
